capabilities: Render timelines from events in code blocks tagged timeline or a timeline-labeled tag
Mark each event's time, title and content with + prefixes or line labels
Choose line and body layout variants with pre-written classes
Set the active event color using Obsidian CSS variables or the --timeline-active-color variable
extras: The README recommends using a CSS snippet (instead of the plugin) for footnotes and node links and combining it with other plugins; authors Welding Torch and Ivan Che are credited.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a sequence of dated events as a visual timeline inside a note.
summary: Timeline renderer that turns tagged event blocks in notes into styled visual timelines via code blocks and CSS classes.
